title: Download materials for the entire course!

cues.en: Instructor: All of the code that you need in this entire course, all the code files, the additional resources, the extra data files,
cues.zh: 整門課需要的所有程式碼、程式檔案、額外資源，以及額外資料檔，

cues.en: everything you need to download for this course is available in the resources folder in this particular video, this video that you are watching right now.
cues.zh: 所有這門課需要下載的內容，都放在這部影片的資源資料夾，也就是你現在正在看的這部。

cues.en: So if you look on the Udemy screen off to the right, you see here's all of the different sections and so on.
cues.zh: 看 Udemy 畫面右邊，可以看到所有不同章節等內容。

cues.en: This is the video that we are watching right now, download materials for this entire course.
cues.zh: 這就是現在看的影片：「下載整門課教材」。

cues.en: You see this little resources button here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個小小的「資源」按鈕。

cues.en: Click on this and then click on this.
cues.zh: 點這個，再點這裡。

cues.en: This will download a zip file locally onto your computer.
cues.zh: 就會把 ZIP 檔下載到電腦。

cues.en: You need this file.
cues.zh: 你需要這個檔案。

cues.en: So you can put this zip file somewhere convenient on your computer.
cues.zh: 可以把 ZIP 放在電腦上方便的位置。

cues.en: And if you look inside the zip file, you will see that there is a folder for each section of the course.
cues.zh: 查看 ZIP 內容，會看到每一章節都有一個資料夾。

cues.en: So for example, this one is confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 例如，這個是信賴區間。

cues.en: This is the section for correlation.
cues.zh: 這個是相關分析那一節。

cues.en: Now, if you go into each one of these folders, you will see some additional files.
cues.zh: 進入各資料夾，會看到其他檔案。

cues.en: So there's going to be all of the Python files.
cues.zh: 包含所有 Python 檔案。

cues.en: So these are all IPython.
cues.zh: 這些都是 IPython，

cues.en: So Jupyter format, Python notebooks.
cues.zh: 也就是 Jupyter 格式的 Python notebook。

cues.en: And then you see a bunch of map files and our M-files for MATLAB.
cues.zh: 接著會看到一批 MATLAB 的 .m 檔案。

cues.en: And there's actually, it looks like there's two of them for each lecture.
cues.zh: 而且看起來每堂講座都有兩個。

cues.en: So what's actually going on is that there is the main file that you would use for MATLAB.
cues.zh: 實際上，其中一個是供 MATLAB 使用的主要檔案。

cues.en: And then if you are working in Octave, because either you don't have access to MATLAB or because you have access to MATLAB but not the statistics and machine learning toolbox,
cues.zh: 如果因為無法使用 MATLAB，或雖然有 MATLAB，卻沒有 Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox，而使用 Octave，

cues.en: then you can use the Octave program with the statistics package installed.
cues.zh: 就能改用安裝了 statistics 套件的 Octave。

cues.en: So you can see that all the files for Octave are called Oct for Octave, and then the ones for MATLAB don't have the Oct in them, of course.
cues.zh: 可以看到，所有供 Octave 使用的檔名，都有代表 Octave 的 Oct；當然，供 MATLAB 使用的就沒有 Oct。

cues.en: Here's a quick update to this video because since recording that initial video that you're watching, I added a new file to this zip file, and that is this,
cues.zh: 這裡快速更新一下，因為錄完你正在看的原始影片後，我在 ZIP 裡新增了一個檔案，就是這個，

cues.en: it's called statsML_video_overviews.
cues.zh: 叫做 statsML_video_overviews。

cues.en: That's an Excel data file.
cues.zh: 這是 Excel 資料檔。

cues.en: And if you open up that file, you will see a file that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 開啟檔案後，會看到大致像這樣的內容。

cues.en: So this list, all of these sections of the course, the video numbers, these are the numbers of the videos that you see in Udemy, and here's all the titles, and here are the descriptions.
cues.zh: 清單列出所有課程章節、影片編號，也就是 Udemy 顯示的編號，以及所有標題與說明。

cues.en: So you can think of this file as like a syllabus or an overview.
cues.zh: 所以可以把這個檔案想成課綱或總覽。

cues.en: And I included this partly because of requests from students.
cues.zh: 我加入它，部分原因是學生提出要求。

cues.en: I thought it was a nice idea, so I did it.
cues.zh: 我覺得是好主意，所以就做了。

cues.en: But also this is great because now you can, you know, for example, CTRL+F or Apple+F, you can search for keywords and see which videos those keywords appear in
cues.zh: 另外它也很好用，例如現在可以按 Ctrl+F 或 Apple+F，搜尋關鍵字，看看哪些影片出現這些關鍵字，

cues.en: and which video numbers in your video player.
cues.zh: 以及它們在播放器中的影片編號。

cues.en: The last thing I wanna mention here is just a quick overview of how each individual code video will work.
cues.zh: 最後要快速概述，每部程式實作影片的進行方式。

cues.en: So I will start off with a screen in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 我會先從 MATLAB 畫面開始。

cues.en: It's gonna look something like this.
cues.zh: 大概長這樣。

cues.en: Now, in the beginning of the coding video, for the first few seconds or maybe a few tens of seconds, I'm gonna provide some general background about the overview of the entire video.
cues.zh: 在影片一開始的幾秒，或幾十秒，我會提供一些一般背景，概述整部影片。

cues.en: So whether you're watching in MATLAB or in Python, you want to watch the beginning little bit of the video.
cues.zh: 所以不論使用 MATLAB 或 Python，都要看影片開頭那一小段。

cues.en: And at some point, I'm gonna have a window pop up in the screen that's gonna say something like this, Python code starts at some timestamp.
cues.zh: 某個時間點，畫面會跳出一個視窗，寫著類似「Python 程式碼從某個時間點開始」。

cues.en: So if you are following along in MATLAB, you just ignore this and continue watching in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 如果用 MATLAB 跟著操作，直接忽略它，繼續看 MATLAB。

cues.en: If you're following along with the Python code, then this is your opportunity to skip over the rest of the MATLAB explanation.
cues.zh: 如果用 Python，這時就能跳過剩下的 MATLAB 解說。

cues.en: So in this case, you would just skip over to minute 10, second 40, and that's when I start showing all the same basic code
cues.zh: 例如這裡，直接跳到 10 分 40 秒，我就會開始展示相同的基本程式碼，

cues.en: implemented in Python.
cues.zh: 但改用 Python 實作。

cues.en: Now, just keep in mind that the concepts are basically the same in MATLAB and Python.
cues.zh: 記得，MATLAB 與 Python 的概念基本相同。

cues.en: The implementations are sometimes very similar, sometimes quite a bit different.
cues.zh: 實作有時很相近，有時差異相當大。

cues.en: So if you are not following along with code but you're still watching the code videos because you want to learn more material, then you don't need to watch both MATLAB and Python.
cues.zh: 如果沒有跟著寫程式，只是為了學更多內容而看實作影片，就不需要把 MATLAB 與 Python 都看完。

cues.en: You can just watch one or the other.
cues.zh: 只看其中一個就好。

cues.en: Probably it's more convenient just to watch the MATLAB section just because then you don't have to worry about hunting down this particular time slot.
cues.zh: 大概直接看 MATLAB 部分比較方便，因為不必費心找特定時間點。

cues.en: So again, as a quick reminder, I will say a few quick words in the beginning of the video, and then you either switch to the Python timestamp
cues.zh: 所以再快速提醒，影片開頭會先說幾句，接著你可以跳到 Python 的時間點，

cues.en: or you continue watching in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 或繼續看 MATLAB。

cues.en: And then when I switched to Python, if you were watching in MATLAB, that would be your opportunity to skip to the next video.
cues.zh: 等我切換到 Python，如果你看的是 MATLAB，那就是可以跳到下一部影片的時候。
